title: Legora and Conga integrate to bring enterprise contracts into the agentic operating system for legal work
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, and Conga, the company lining up commerce, announced an integration that brings contracts managed in Conga Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) directly into the Legora platform.
body_markdown:
Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, and Conga, the company lining up commerce, today announced an integration that brings contracts managed in Conga Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) directly into the Legora platform. In-house legal teams that use both platforms will first be able to pull Conga contracts into Legora for drafting, review, research, and due diligence; later phases will let them save their work back to Conga and find contracts by describing them in plain language.


Enterprise legal teams depend on their CLM to keep agreements organized, current, and governed. But the legal work around those agreements, from drafting on proven terms to reviewing hundreds of contracts for a single clause, often happens in other tools, leaving lawyers to download files, re-upload them elsewhere, and reconcile versions by hand. The integration is built to reduce those handoffs.


“Enterprises trust Conga with the contracts their business runs on, and their lawyers shouldn’t have to export those contracts to put AI to work on them,” said Gabriel Quek, Senior Director of Technology Partnerships at Legora. “We’re starting by bringing Conga contracts into Legora and saving each updated draft straight back to Conga, connecting the system where contracts are managed to the platform where legal work gets done.”


Conga CLM gives enterprises a governed home for their agreements, from first draft through renewal. Legora brings agentic AI to the work lawyers do on those agreements: research, review, drafting, and due diligence. Connecting the two lets lawyers apply that AI to contracts already in Conga, while Conga remains the system of record.


The integration will roll out in three phases:


-


**Conga contracts, ready for legal work in Legora** : In the first phase, mutual customers will be able to pull contracts from Conga CLM directly into Legora and use them as templates for drafting, or for analysis, legal research, summaries, redlining and editing, due diligence, and Tabular Reviews. Conga’s access controls will also carry through to Legora automatically, so users can only pull in contracts they can already access in Conga.


-


**Edits saved back to Conga, with permissions intact** : The second phase will let mutual customers save edits made in Legora directly back to the document’s original location in Conga, as a new version, a new document, or in place of the original. Conga’s access controls apply automatically, so users can only save over documents they have permission to change.


-


**Natural-language contract search** : The third phase will let mutual customers find the right contracts in Conga by describing them, such as every supplier agreement signed with a given vendor in the past six months, without browsing and selecting files across folders and subfolders. Users can then pull in the relevant contracts for end-to-end work in Legora.


"Our customers have to manage a large number of contracts efficiently, and their legal teams want AI that understands legal work," said Brian Farr, VP of Product Management at Conga. "With Legora connected to Conga CLM, they can apply AI directly to the agreements they already manage with us. As the integration expands, the work lawyers do in Legora will flow back into Conga, so sales, finance, and procurement keep working from the same record."


Conga joins a growing ecosystem of Legora integrations that connect the agentic operating system for legal work to the systems enterprises already depend on. Further detail and availability for each phase will be communicated to mutual customers over time.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 130,000 legal professionals at more than 2,000 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.


**About Conga**


Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line. Learn more at Conga.com.
